stageManifest.method: Explicit source paths plus individually enumerated JSON/patch evidence files; excludes prior user changes and backups

artifactPrivacy.limitation: Pattern scan plus targeted diff review, not proof against every possible secret format

limitations: Historical development session anomaly accepted by explicit exception, not resolved
Underlying host latency variation remains a risk
Local Flutter results include protected local changes; CI checks only committed files
Physical camera, speaker and TV acceptance not repeated
